subject.title: feat(sandbox): add skipSkillsSync config option to suppress skill sync

question: Should OpenClaw add a permanent Docker `skipSkillsSync` contract, and if so must it retain discoverable preinstalled skills rather than only suppressing all local skill instructions?
rationale: The final implementation is a different product mode from the linked request, while repository policy requires owner judgment before adding public configuration that changes sandbox skill availability.

options.title: Define preinstalled-skills contract
options.body: Specify verified Docker-side discovery or read-only mounting so skipped copies still provide usable skill instructions.

options.title: Use existing no-skills control
options.body: Decline the new option and direct deployments that need no local skills to the existing skills allowlist.

options.title: Approve suppression-only mode
options.body: Accept a distinct mode that disables all local skill instructions, with clearer naming, documentation, and upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Define preinstalled-skills contract
recommendation.body: Specify verified Docker-side discovery or read-only mounting so skipped copies still provide usable skill instructions.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies steipete as the strongest sandbox backend and operator-contract owner candidate for this product choice.
